preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain control of owner address)
Contract must not be deprecated (deprecated == false)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call deprecate() with a malicious upgradedAddress that implements UpgradedStandardToken interface. The malicious contract should have transferByLegacy, transferFromByLegacy, and approveByLegacy functions that allow arbitrary token transfers to the attacker. After deprecation, all token operations will be routed through the malicious contract, enabling theft of all user funds.
